title: Regulation of exercise ability and glycolipid metabolism by synthetic SR9009 analogues as new REV-ERB-alpha agonists.
authors: Li, Lei; Yang, Chaofu; Qiao, Xuehong; Yang, Xingxing; Zhang, Jinyan; Cui, Menghan; Li, Zhongwen; Tian, Airong; Li, Xiheng; Zou, Xiaocui; Li, Yiran; He, Weihui; Chen, Yuan; He, Xinhua
one_liner_zh: 该文为小分子SR9009类似物的合成与药效评价，研究其对REV-ERB-alpha的激动活性及运动/糖脂代谢调节，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: SR9009 is an activator of REV-ERBs with diverse biological activities, including improving exercise tolerance and controlling skeletal muscle mass. To optimise the carbamate motif of SR9009, analogues of SR9009 were synthesised and evaluated. All of them showed REV-ERB-alpha agonist activities. Among them, 5a, 5f, 5 g, 5m, and 5p showed potencies equivalent to or slightly higher than the potency of SR9009 in vitro. These data indicate that the halogenated benzyl group is an indispensable active group in these compounds. 5m, 5p and SR9009 improved exercise tolerance in normal mice in vivo. Additionally, in hyperlipidemic mice, 5m and 5p not only improved exercise tolerance but also lowered blood lipid levels. 5m and 5p displayed stronger hypoglycaemic activity than SR9009.
abstract_zh: SR9009是REV-ERBs的激活剂，具有多种生物活性，包括提高运动耐量和控制骨骼肌质量。为了优化SR9009的氨基甲酸酯基团，合成了SR9009的类似物并进行了评估。所有类似物均表现出REV-ERB-α激动剂活性。其中，5a、5f、5g、5m和5p在体外显示出与SR9009相当或略高的效力。这些数据表明，卤代苄基在这些化合物中是不可或缺的活性基团。5m、5p和SR9009在体内提高了正常小鼠的运动耐量。此外，在高脂血症小鼠中，5m和5p不仅提高了运动耐量，还降低了血脂水平。5m和5p表现出比SR9009更强的降血糖活性。
